note: Every non-ASCII symbol the tapestry prints is defined here, and every symbol defined here is printed there (gym/check-tapestry.mjs, both directions). The tapestry carries symbols; this file carries the words. One cell each: measured 2026-10-01 in the GitHub code font (gym/glyph-ink.json). Operator glyphs follow organs/cube.mjs: the canon is ∅ ○ ● ｜ ⋈ △ ⊢ ⊨ ↬; ｜ ⋈ ⊢ measure 1.66 / 1.28 / 1.25 cells and would break a framed column, so they print as | → = (the EOT surface marks for cut, bond, define).

∅.means: hold the void: declare absence, draw the null, name the gap

○.means: attend: register a difference, sign an origin

|.means: cut: draw or dissolve a boundary

△.means: compose: an emergent whole from parts

=.means: define: what holds within a frame

↬.means: restructure the frame when judgment breaks it

∘.means: Void · the hub · 0 · the ambient a figure is read against

◆.means: Beings · the spokes · n · one difference from its ground

◈.means: Fold · the rim · 1 · the difference a figure made to the next ground

⊞.means: how things hang together: SEG CON SYN

∀.means: what the reader holds: DEF EVA REC

◀.means: WHAT is done: mode × domain = the operator

▲.means: WHERE it lands: domain × grain = the terrain

▶.means: HOW it is done: mode × grain = the stance

■.means: resident in Penelope, checked against the repo

□.means: lives in the house, read at home, never forked

·.means: a named void: nothing is claimed, only a gap and the control that would falsify it

§.means: the cell typing is in the house's own documents (THE-27-CELLS.md)

‡.means: this tapestry's own typing of the act; a pointing, never a proof

∨.means: alternatives; in the pipeline, in order, the first that answers wins

↺.means: name why, sharpen, re-draw; bounded by a budget

↑.means: LOW gate: the level below sets what the level above may be

↓.means: HIGH gate: the level above sets how likely the level below is

≡.means: matched in the corpus, by frame, snipped with an address

⇒✗.means: the condition written before it, once observed, kills the thread

◇.means: the hub jewel; Indra's net: every thread is mirrored on the faces, the holons, the helix and the ring

▫.means: an empty cell: declared, not yet filled

◦.means: the path of one turn of the wheel: Ground (hub), Figure (spokes), Pattern (rim)
